text:
Mira: Heads-up — new model bundle uploaded: helix11b-lite v1. Can we triage perf + quantization today?
Jasper: On it. Is this P0 (customer-facing) or P1 (internal)?
Mira: P1 for now, but could flip to P0 if int8 looks good. Eval set added: helix-qc-v1.
Alex: Which target context length? 2k or 4k? I suggest we run 512/2048/4096 sweeps.
Sam: I can kick off throughput/latency runs on cluster-infer-h100-02. Plan: bs 1/2/4/8, ctx 512/2048/4096, fp16 + int8.
Jasper: Sounds good. Primary metrics: p95 latency, median tok/s, and memory headroom. Also collect kv cache memory by step.
Sam: Running an int8 smoke first (short):
```
run_bench --model helix11b-lite --mode int8 --bs 8 --ctx 4096 --tokens 10000 --node cluster-infer-h100-02
```
benchbot: Job queued: bench-2387 (helix11b-lite int8 bs8 ctx4096) on cluster-infer-h100-02. ETA ~35m.
Alex: Quick rule: if int8 p95 <= fp16 p95 * 1.3 and tok/s >= 0.85(fp16) then we prefer int8. Otherwise fallback to fp16 + batching.
Jasper: Also run small ctx sweep for cold-start latency (ctx 128/512) to check KV warmup behaviour. Cold-start p50 matters for interactive.
Mira: I've pushed a canary flag: feature.helix-lite-v1.canary so we can gate rollout.
Sam: Noted. I'll attach raw logs + flamegraphs to the job when done.
Alex: Reminder: run the qa hallucination eval in parallel (helix-qc-v1) to spot quality regressions early. If regression > 3% fail, block canary.
Mira: Done, eval set is wired into the CI eval runner. @benchbot can you trigger eval once bench completes?
benchbot: Will trigger eval-112 after bench-2387 finishes.
Jasper: I'll summarize results and recommended rollout (int8 canary / fp16 fallback) in ~45m. Thanks team :thumbsup:
